android.scope: First light fixed-object static optical feasibility. Six fresh production GlassSlider scenes, each independently repeated with the original shape and pose-matched flat source. Real DOWN, slop-establishing MOVE, inverse-mapped target MOVE, settled HELD capture, cleanup CANCEL. No setValue, source motion, UP commit, release-dynamics or parity claim.
android.input_policy: The requested carrier center is converted analytically through the unchanged production relative drag mapping. DOWN starts at the observed quarter REST carrier. A real MOVE11dp crosses the production10dp slop, then a second real MOVE requests the inverse-mapped fraction. Actual pointer dispatch, values and carrier LayoutCoordinates are exported. Nominal source overlap is not actual optical coverage.
android.clock_policy: LocalDockInputTimeNanos uses the Compose clock;1600ms settling after DOWN and each MOVE. Requested event delays and actual dispatch uptime are recorded independently. This is settled static evidence, not a millisecond motion measurement.
android.capture_policy: Actual Window PixelCopy and independent composited display PNGs, unchanged>=99.5% RGB3 readiness and whole-holder/carrier6dp shadow room requirements. Each pose has its own unchanged-source background baseline.
android.production_shader_compile_and_bind: passed: light single/range, lift0/0.5/1; not exhaustive driver introspection
